name: Image IP and Safety Check
description: Vision check before listing: a brand, a known character, a real person or unsafe content in an image; for a lifestyle hero photo, a visible child (blurred background included) or something covering the print (pass image.compare's print box). Claude Haiku via the llm relay, about $0.0005 a call. Fail closed: ok false means NOT clear.
requires: the owner's llm_provider_anthropic_enabled switch and an llm_daily_cap_anthropic above 0
aliases: is this image safe to list
